scientific_integrity: A complete self-contained finite algorithm, full 84-row and 21-cycle catalogs, explicit comparisons, and reproducibility checks are supplied. Claims of independent verification or previously established external certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification restricted to the ternary length-three de Bruijn graph; no asymptotic or larger-parameter assertion. The standard framework and generic enumeration procedures are credited to earlier work. An unindexed equivalent census or auxiliary software may exist.
title: Complete ternary three-mer minimum decycling-set census and sharp avoidance lengths
